blocks.text: More than 1,000 runners, families, fitness enthusiasts, and Halloween revelers came together for Ghoul Run 2026, held on October 24 at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds. This included Concierges and Hoteliers based in 5 Star Hotels in Manila, Clark, Cebu and Boracay. Organized by Les Clefs d’Or Philippines in partnership with Smoke10 Events Management, the event combined fitness, Halloween festivities, and community engagement through 1K, 3K, 5K, and 10K race categories. Participants of all ages joined the night run, many in creative Halloween costumes. The event also featured entertainment, giveaways, and opportunities for members of the hospitality, business, and local communities […]...
